prompt: This blood pressure drug commonly used to treat gestational hypertension was patented the same year the first black student at the University of Mississippi was shot.
answer: The drug is **labetalol**. It was patented in **1966**, the same year James Meredith—the first Black student at the University of Mississippi—was shot during his civil-rights march. Labetalol is commonly used to manage hypertension during pregnancy, including gestational hypertension and preeclampsia.
